English: Clearing Patch
A roughly cleared area in the dense Central African forest, serving as the first step to establishing a foothold for a nomadic camp.
Leaf Hut
Simple huts built from woven leaves and branches, providing basic shelter and modest organization for the growing camp.
Wooden Shelter
Solid wooden shelters are constructed, offering improved protection from the elements and supporting a larger nomadic population.
Rain Pavilion
A large, semi-permanent structure with a raised platform and broad leaf roofing, protecting the camp from tropical downpours and improving logistics.
Guarded Camp
The camp is fortified with watch platforms and patrols, providing protection from predators and rival clans.
Hunters Room
A communal hall for hunters, used for storing game, planning expeditions, and honing martial skills unique to the forest environment.
Family Hall
A sturdy, multi-roomed hall for the clans families, encouraging unity, healthy growth, and stability within the heart of the forest.
Community Pavilion
A large gathering hall for tribal councils, celebrations, and rituals, fostering clan unity and coordination for great undertakings.
Chiefs Chamber
A grand private chamber for the clan chief, signifying prestige, leadership, and a center of command for all tribal matters.
Central African Forest Camp

The ultimate expression of nomadic mastery in the Central African forest: a massive, fortified camp with palisades, granaries, and halls, sustaining thousands and serving as the beating heart of a powerful forest clan.
